decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's ergonomic office lighting know-how, but it is a peripheral catalogue item outside its project-based core, so the withdrawal risk stays moderate.
As a second-generation interior luminaire, it builds directly on the firm's LED, optics and in-house testing knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship rooted in the firm's own optics research and its glare-free, efficient lighting strategy, so management will keep investing in it.

The searchlight uses the firm's marine specialist knowledge, but HMI technology diverges from its LED-focused research, and the withdrawal of the naval line signals pruning in the marine segment, which raises the drop risk.
The marine searchlight fits the firm's robust-lighting competence and can be upgraded with its LED knowledge, though the naval line's withdrawal adds some risk.
